predictRound.practiceNote: Practice money only — no real funds.
predictRound.empty: No predictions yet. Pick Over or Under to make your first one.
predictRound.rules1_one: Pick a round length: 1, 5 or 15 minutes. This round lasts {{mins}} minute{{quarters}}. Price to beat is {{name}}'s price when the round opened.
predictRound.rules1_other: Pick a round length: 1, 5 or 15 minutes. This round lasts {{mins}} minutes{{quarters}}. Price to beat is {{name}}'s price when the round opened.
predictRound.rules2: Pick <up>Over</up> if you think it closes above that price, <dn>Under</dn> if below. The % is the live chance of each, from how far the price is from the target, the time left and recent volatility; the multiplier is what $1 pays if you're right.
predictRound.rules3: Predictions close {{secs}} seconds before the round ends and settle on the round's closing price. An exact tie returns your stake.
predictRound.rules4: You play with a {{amount}} practice wallet — no real money is involved.
